name: zscore_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the index price deviates more than 2 standard deviations from its 10-minute rolling mean, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms and intraday mean-reversion quants begin fading the move aggressively — they are getting fills 20-35 spot points away from recent equilibrium, which is statistically extreme at the 5-10 minute scale. The z-score velocity filter (30-second rate of change turning back toward zero) confirms the order flow rotation has begun before the full reversion impulse lands, allowing entry in the first 5 seconds of the bounce rather than waiting for a 1-minute bar confirmation. This is a pure price-level reversion signal: NIFTY's index construction (cap-weighted, 50 liquid large caps) means deviations from the 10-minute mean are quickly arbitraged by index futures market-makers keeping spot-futures basis tight.
core_signal_oneliner: Price z-score beyond ±2.0 sigma from 10-minute rolling mean with 30-second z-score velocity turning back toward zero (reversion onset confirmed)
